name: genpark-codebase-dead-code-unreachable-pruner-skill
description: AST-level static call-graph analyzer and dead code pruner identifying orphaned functions, unreachable methods, and token-bloat clusters.
author: AlphaPark

tools.name: build_call_graph
tools.description: Construct directed caller-callee call graph from Python source code.

tools.name: find_unreachable_symbols
tools.description: Identify unreferenced functions and classes from specified entry points.

tools.name: calculate_token_savings
tools.description: Estimate lines of code and LLM token savings from dead code elimination.

tools.name: run_benchmark_dead_code_pruning
tools.description: Execute dead code pruning test cases on sample codebase.
